Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. Per our call I wanted to book a short technical demo so Marissa can walk through the end-to-end inference flow and the ops/SLAs. A few windows that work for us next week:

- Tue 3/7 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 3/8 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 3/9 09:00–09:30 PT

All sessions would be a 25-min demo + 5-min quick next steps. Let me know which slot you prefer and whether we should include any additional folks from the Magellan product team.

I attached the one-pager and an MVP checklist that Marissa will reference during the walkthrough.

Best,

Hey Mina — thanks for the options and the material. Quick update from our side: executive leadership re-prioritized our Q2 roadmap this morning to focus on the upcoming platform launch (internal code-name "Vela"). That means non-critical pilots are being paused and our LLM/inference evaluation is being pushed out until at least Q4.

For now we should park scheduling for the demo. Two quick asks:
1) Can you add us to a waitlist / milestone reminder so we can re-open this when priorities settle?
2) If possible, could Marissa share a short 10–12 slide deck or an async recording we can review so we don't lose the context?

No decision yet on the contract side; we'll be back in touch once the Vela launch plan is stable. Appreciate your flexibility.

—Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Platform Engineering | Magellan Systems
tom.ellis@magellan.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Hi Tom —

Totally understand — congrats on the Vela launch focus. We can absolutely pause formal scheduling. A couple things we'll do from our side to keep this lightweight:

- I'll record a 12-minute asynchronous walkthrough of the proposed evaluation path (architecture, sample prompts, cost estimates) and upload the video + slides.
- I'll also attach a short checklist you can hand to engineering/product when you're ready again.
- Mina, I can create a calendar placeholder for early November (Q4) with a gentle reminder 6 weeks out; we won't put any invites on the calendar until Magellan gives the go-ahead.

Action items:
- Marissa to upload recording + slides by Wed 3/7 EOD PST [Attachment: magellan-async-walkthrough.mp4 (video stub), Magellan_eval_deck.pdf]
- Mina to add waitlist status + update HubSpot deal stage to "Paused — customer prioritization" (MAG-2028-0051)

Tom — I'll include a 1-page technical handoff you can share with your SREs so they can keep the configuration notes handy. If you prefer an architecture-only doc instead of a recording, say the word.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

I'll mark MAG-2028-0051 as "Paused — customer prioritization" in HubSpot and set a follow-up task for 2028-10-01 to reach back out. We also added you to our internal waitlist so you'll get an automated milestone email when we open new Q4 demo slots.
